metadata.name: trade
metadata.description: LocalMoney Trade Program - Core P2P exchange logic

instructions.name: accept_trade
docs: Seller accepts a buyer's trade request.
* `ctx` - AcceptTrade context with trade PDA, seller, offer
Only the offer owner (seller) can accept the trade.

accounts.name: seller
docs: The seller accepting the trade (must be offer owner)

instructions.name: cancel_trade
docs: Cancels a trade before escrow is funded.
* `ctx` - CancelTrade context with trade PDA, canceler
Buyer or seller can cancel before escrow is funded.
- Only allowed before escrow is funded

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification

instructions.name: check_expiration
docs: Check and mark trade as expired
Marks a trade as expired if the expiration timer has passed.
Anyone can call this to mark expired trades.
- Only transitions if current timestamp > expires_at

accounts.name: buyer_profile
docs: Buyer's profile (for counter update if expired)

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification

instructions.name: confirm_fiat_deposit
docs: Buyer confirms they have received the off-chain fiat payment.
* `ctx` - ConfirmFiatDeposit context with trade PDA, buyer
Only the buyer can confirm fiat deposit.

instructions.name: create_trade
docs: Creates a trade request against an existing offer.
* `ctx` - CreateTrade context with trade PDA, counter, offer, buyer, profiles, hub config
* `params` - Trade parameters (offer_id, amount, fiat_amount, contact info)
Anyone can create a trade, subject to limits from Hub config.
- Validates offer exists and is Active
- Checks amount within offer's min/max range
- Enforces max_active_trades limit via Profile CPI
- Sets expiration timer from Hub config

accounts.name: buyer_profile
docs: Buyer's profile (for limit checking and counter update)

accounts.name: hub_config
docs: Hub config (for trade limits and expiration timer)

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA (will be derived and passed in)

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification

instructions.name: fund_escrow
docs: The appropriate party (buyer or seller, depending on offer type) deposits
* `ctx` - FundEscrow context with trade PDA, funder, token accounts, escrow vault
- For Buy offers: seller funds escrow
- For Sell offers: buyer funds escrow
- Validates funder is correct party based on offer type
- Transfers exact trade amount to escrow vault

accounts.name: funder
docs: The party funding escrow (buyer or seller depending on offer type)

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA (will be initialized by escrow program via CPI)

accounts.name: vault_token_account
docs: Escrow vault's token account (ATA controlled by vault PDA)

accounts.name: offer
docs: The offer (to determine who should fund and validate it's still active)

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification

instructions.name: initialize_counter
docs: This must be called once before any trades can be created.
It initializes the global trade counter PDA.

instructions.name: initiate_dispute
docs: Starts the dispute resolution process by assigning an arbitrator
* `ctx` - InitiateDispute context with trade PDA, arbitrator registry
Buyer or seller can initiate dispute after escrow funded.
- Assigns arbitrator via Arbitrator program CPI
- Freezes escrow via Escrow program CPI

accounts.name: initiator
docs: The party initiating dispute (buyer or seller)

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification

instructions.name: refund_trade
docs: Returns escrowed tokens to the depositor after escrow was funded.
* `ctx` - RefundTrade context with trade PDA, token accounts
Buyer or seller can initiate refund after escrow funded.
- Returns full amount (no fees on refunds)

accounts.name: refunder
docs: The party initiating refund (buyer or seller)

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification

instructions.name: release_escrow
docs: Releases tokens from escrow to the recipient with automatic fee distribution.
* `ctx` - ReleaseEscrow context with all token accounts, profiles, hub config
- Distributes fees to treasury, warchest, and arbitrator (if disputed)
- Updates both buyer and seller profile statistics

accounts.name: releaser
docs: The party initiating release (seller for normal flow, or arbitrator for disputes)

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: Recipient's token account (buyer or seller depending on offer type and dispute)

accounts.name: arbitrator_token_account
docs: Arbitrator token account (for arbitrator fee if disputed)

accounts.name: offer
docs: The offer (to determine recipient and offer type)

accounts.name: trade_program
docs: The Trade program account for CPI caller identification
